create_Vocoder: create a Vocoder module with a CodeGenerator and language-speaker index mapping
run_Vocoder_forward: run the Vocoder forward pass with speech units, language list, and speaker IDs to synthesize audio
build_Vocoder_multilingual: build a Vocoder instance for multilingual speech synthesis with language-speaker index map
test_Vocoder_batch: test the Vocoder forward pass with batched units and per-sample language-speaker assignments
review_Vocoder_forward: review the Vocoder forward method that converts units to audio with duration prediction
